summary.intent: Execute phase 22 (performance-baselines-completion) plans using GSD wave-based parallel execution, after first fixing an issue where phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 planning commits were moved to feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion, main was reset to match origin/main, and phase 22 execution was initiated with 3 parallel subagents spawned for plans 22-01, 22-02, and 22-03.

repo: Phase 22 is 'performance-baselines-completion' — covers SDK perf instrumentation, E2E journey timing, and load test thresholds
Phase 22 plans are all in wave 1 (no inter-plan dependencies), enabling full parallelization
GSD branching strategy for this project uses 'phase' strategy with branch naming pattern feat/phase-{N}-{slug}
Planning commits (research, plans) were going to main directly — project convention expects them on a feature branch
workflow: GSD execute-phase init JSON includes executor_model, verifier_model, branching_strategy, branch_name, and plan inventory
When feature branch already exists from a prior git operation, GSD's branching step can be skipped by checking current branch first
The auto-chain flag (_auto_chain_active) must be cleared at execute-phase init when not invoked with --auto to prevent stale state from prior interrupted runs
Moving commits to a feature branch: create branch at current HEAD (captures commits), then hard-reset main to origin/main

friction: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch, requiring a branch restructure before execution could begin
GSD init computed a branch name (phase-22-performance-baselines-completion) without the 'feat/' prefix, but the manually created branch used 'feat/' prefix — required manual reconciliation
open_items: 3 subagents (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) were spawned but transcript ends before completion — wave 1 execution, spot-checks, verification, and roadmap update are pending
Commits are on feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion but have not been pushed to origin — PR creation is deferred
